narrative.details:
This book tells the tale of an elemental princess, Myzrael, and of her imprisonment deep underneath the Arathi Highlands.

It also tells of a secret outcropping of crystals in the highlands.  These crystals, the Shards of Myzrael, are a window to the princess' prison.

If a brave soul found the Shards of Myzrael, the perhaps he/she could speak with her...
